invariants.description: total pump amount q_1+q_2+q_3+q_4 is conserved (relative drift < 1e-6)
second law: every reaction dissipates, so Power_dissipation >= 0
energy balance (exact identity): Power_external - Power_dissipation = sum_i u_i dq_i/dt with u_i = RT ln(K_i q_i), dq_1/dt = v_4 - v_1 etc.
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Power_external - Power_dissipation - 0.0025773*(np.log(K_1*q_1)*(v_4 - v_1) + np.log(K_2*q_2)*(v_1 - v_2) + np.log(K_3*q_3)*(v_2 - v_3) + np.log(K_4*q_4)*(v_3 - v_4)))) <= 1e-6 * max(1e-12, np.max(np.abs(Power_external)))

invariants.description: cycle steady state at t_end: v_1 = v_2 = v_3 = v_4, so Na+ efflux (3 v_4) : K+ influx (2 v_1) = 3 : 2 and net charge 1 e per cycle (relative 1e-4)

v_NKE equals the exact rapid-equilibrium (kappa_1, kappa_3 -> infinity) steady-state flux of the module's own reaction scheme (two-pool cycle q_1+q_2, q_3+q_4; relative 1e-6). Algebraic check, independent of the ODE solution.

bc_sweep.rationale: K_1..K_4, kappa_2 and kappa_4 have no sourced values (all 1); a two-decade log range around 1 is swept as the claimed working region. z_1 spans -0.5..0.5, which covers both the current value 0.5 and the Pan et al. (2020) charge split (-0.055 on the intracellular Na+ binding step). flag_0 is a switch: 0 holds u_e at -0.12 V, 1 ramps it at 1 mV/s.

baseline.reason: candidate: steady-state Na/K pump current-voltage curves in guinea-pig ventricular myocytes (nakao1989dependence, J Gen Physiol 94:539; the data terkildsen2007balance and pan2020cardiac fitted). This needs sourced K/kappa values first (the current values are all 1) and pump current I = F v_4 per pump. It also needs u_e as a sweepable input: it is hard-coded through q_mem_init.

calibrate.note: pending: as baseline: fit K_1..K_4, kappa_2, kappa_4, z_1 to the nakao1989dependence I-V data (via pan2020cardiac) once u_e and the ion amounts are exposed as parameters
